title: Holistic Approach to Measure Sample-level Adversarial Vulnerability and its Utility in Building Trustworthy Systems
benchmark_measurement: Not applicable. The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. Its focus is on adversarial vulnerability in computer vision models.
findings: This paper does not contain any findings related to religion or faith. The research focuses on technical aspects of adversarial attacks, model robustness, and trustworthiness in the context of computer vision, specifically using the CIFAR-10 image dataset.
